propositions: A new plan-review criterion T15 'overlay-derisk' must be added to require proving risky runtime-only mechanisms through fast out-of-loop experiments before committing them to slow codified delivery loops (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning).

T15 applies when a mechanism is delivered via automated pipeline, that pass is slow or costly, and correctness is runtime-only (boot, auth, connection, readiness); the rubric must verify named-risk identification, fast out-of-loop proof, prove-then-codify ordering, and scoped cleanup of transient artifacts.

T10's rubric must be updated with a scope clause partitioning durable infrastructure from transient de-risk experiments, ensuring no overlap between T15's transient-experiment phase and T10's production-hardening phase.

The criterion must be registered, self-gating via Pass-1 finder, stack-agnostic, and rendered via 'rebar explain T15' with accompanying updates to writing-a-passing-plan guide and regenerated criteria-guide documentation.
